Farmer Dies in Lightning Strike While Sowing Paddy in Uttar Pradesh

A farmer has died after being struck by lightning while sowing paddy in Deoria district, Uttar Pradesh. The incident occurred while the farmer was working in an agricultural field. Local police confirmed the death.
